tasks.description: In docs/source/build-with-bentoml/runtime-environment.rst, under the 'Configuration methods' section of the Image class, add a new subsection documenting the `build_include(*file_paths)` method: it accepts one or more paths relative to the bento context root, appends them to the build include list, and returns self for chaining. Include a code example such as `bentoml.images.Image(python_version='3.11').build_include("data/", "config.yaml")` and note that included files are copied into the image under ./src/<name>.
